hostRules.description: Cap concurrent github.com requests to bound peak memory. The terraform manager fetches and unzips EVERY platform build of a provider to compute its h1: hash, at the default queue concurrency of 16. oracle/oci ships 13 platform zips (~65MiB each), so that fan-out OOMKills the runner's 1500Mi build container — and the Kubernetes executor's attach strategy never notices the death, so the job idles until the job timeout. Costs wall-clock only on lockfile branches.

packageRules.description: Keep .gitlab-ci.yml include refs SHA-pinned to main via the custom regex manager; disable the built-in gitlabci-include manager so it never proposes tag bumps (e.g. v0.0.48) for security.
